lines.t: Yeah—hands up, light it up!
Shabbat Shalom in the rhythm of love—come on!
Hit that groove, feel that fire, let’s go!
On the Sabbath, slow it down, take a breath, unwind,
Let no unclean word ever cross your mind.
Only praise, only beauty, let it roll,
Shine that light, let it take control.
Peace in your soul, feet on holy ground,
Candlelight glow, blessings all around.
Rest in love, let His Spirit move,
Shabbat Shalom, yeah, feel that groove!
Let grace be your covering, soft on your skin,
Gentleness and love start deep within.
Humility your melody, truth your tone,
You’re never alone—He’s bringing you home.
Shabbat Shalom—feel the rhythm flow!
Move your body, let your praises show.
Hands in the air, sing YahuShua’s song,
Dance to the truth, we’ve been free all along!
Shabbat Shalom—yeah, glory’s your crown!
He lifts you up, never lets you down.
Grace in the groove, it’s coverin’ me,
Mercy and rhythm in perfect harmony.
Gentleness, kindness, walk that line,
We’re shining bright by design.
No hate, no fear, no doubt allowed,
Holy fire lights the crowd!
Kingdom joy in the sound we make,
Shabbat Shalom for heaven’s sake!
Crown of glory, I see it shine,
The promise of love through space and time.
Lift your head, don’t lose that flame,
YahuShua calls your name!
(Yeah, yeah, yeah!)
Shabbat Shalom—feel the rhythm flow,
Move your body, let your praises show.
Hands in the air, sing YahuShua’s song,
Dance to the truth, we’ve been free all along!
Shabbat Shalom—yeah, glory’s your crown,
He lifts you up, never lets you down!
Shabbat Shalom (hey!)
Crown of glory (yeah!)
On the Sabbath we rejoice—
In His love, we lift our voice!
Shabbat Shalom!
